title: ForecastCompass: Guiding Agentic Forecasting with Adaptive Factor Memory
abstract: arXiv:2605.30858v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic forecasting is important for decision-making in dynamic environments, but it remains challenging because agents must reason from incomplete, time-limited evidence and produce calibrated probabilities before outcomes are resolved. Memory provides a natural mechanism for transferring experience from resolved forecasts to future prediction tasks. However, existing agent-memory methods are not tailored to forecasting, as they typically store past interactions, reflections, or factual associations without explicitly representing reusable predictive factors or calibration knowledge. We propose ForecastCompass (FoCo), an adaptive factor-based memory framework for agentic forecasting. FoCo organizes forecasting experience with a hierarchical forecasting-task taxonomy, enabling retrieval task-relevant forecasting knowledge. translated_title: ForecastCompass：用自适应因子记忆引导智能体预测
translated_abstract: 智能体预测对于动态环境中的决策制定非常重要，但它仍然具有挑战性，因为智能体必须在不完整、有时限的证据基础上进行推理，并在结果揭晓之前产生经过校准的概率预测。记忆为将已解决预测中的经验迁移到未来预测任务提供了一种自然的机制。然而，现有的智能体记忆方法并非专为预测任务设计，它们通常存储过去的交互、反思或事实关联，而没有显式地表示可复用的预测因子或校准知识。我们提出了ForecastCompass（FoCo），这是一个面向智能体预测的基于自适应因子的记忆框架。FoCo通过分层预测任务分类体系来组织预测经验，从而实现与任务相关的预测知识的检索。它维护两个互补的记忆组件：因子记忆，用于捕捉可复用的预测维度（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了ForecastCompass（FoCo），一个面向智能体预测的自适应因子记忆框架，通过分层任务分类体系组织预测经验，并维护因子记忆与校准知识两类互补记忆，实现可复用预测知识的检索，从而提升动态环境下的概率预测能力。
en_tdlr: ForecastCompass (FoCo) is an adaptive factor-based memory framework for agentic forecasting that organizes forecasting experience via a hierarchical task taxonomy and maintains complementary factor and calibration memories to retrieve reusable predictive knowledge for better-calibrated probability forecasts.
